designation: National Treasure No. 70 / UNESCO Memory of the World
hook: A writing system appears with its own source code.
summary_en: The book that explains why Hangul was invented and how its letters work.
summary_ko: 한글이 왜 만들어졌고 어떻게 작동하는지 설명하는 문자 창제의 원본 기록입니다.

sections.why_this_matters: For Museum as Code, this is the conceptual anchor: a language object that explains its own design decisions.
sections.what_you_are_looking_at: The Haerye edition contains King Sejong’s preface and examples, followed by scholarly explanations of the principles behind the letters. It is not merely a display of beautiful script; it is a technical document about phonology, access, and design.
sections.the_story: Published in 1446, Hunminjeongeum made a new alphabet public and explained it with unusual clarity. In this project, the `.hgl` panel is not decoration beside the manuscript; it is a contemporary echo of Korea’s long habit of treating language as infrastructure.
